FN-INM1WZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 298
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/21/2023
House Bill 298 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Attorney
General for the enforcement of certain consumer protections regarding device filters provided by
this bill; however, these obligations may be offset by any civil penalties, attorney's fees
investigation expenses that are recovered from violations of the provisions of this act and
retained by the Attorney General.
Page 1

FN-INM1WZ-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 298
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/24/2023
House Bill 298 as passed the House of Representatives could increase the administrative
obligations of the Attorney General for the enforcement of certain consumer protections
regarding device filters provided by this bill; however, these obligations may be offset by any
civil penalties, attorney's fees, or investigation expenses that are recovered from violators of the
provisions of this act and retained by the Attorney General.
